title: Fun tour
text: Great fun experience,  Our cook and guide was Ya Ya and he was very informative,  He pointed out fun facts and different sections of Barcelona on our way to the market,  The cooking experience was a lot of fun and the food came out fabulous and there was plenty of sangria to go with it all.
author: Stay63288

title: Best Paella I’ve Ever Had!
text: We had such an amazing time with our guide Alberto! Not only it was educational, but it was so much fun and probably the best paella I’ve ever had!
author: Q6947VDerint

title: Amazing paella and a really good time
text: This was a fabulous experience. The center of this was our chef and guide Hugo with an assist from Kim. He was full of life and made the experience fun. Also he guided us in creating the best paella I ate in my 2 months living in Spain. We ran into Hugo on the street a few days later and it was like running into an old friend. Highly recommend this experience. 🥰
author: Trek57793091721

title: Paella and more
text: Outstanding class with amazing instructors. Hugo & Alberto made the experience fun and educational.  Would highly recommend this to anyone who enjoys cooking and learning about Spanish culture
author: Matthew_F

title: Book it - so much fun
text: Wow wow wow   What a great day.  We had Yanos and  Simon and was amazing. The cooking class was incredible and the food amazing.

title: Amazing experience!
text: Ianto was an amazing teacher!! We had so much fun and would take another class with him again!!

title: Simply the BEST!
text: We had a blast and made the most delicious food.  Gita is not only an excellent chef, he is an even better teacher!  Therese was awesome too!!!  The seafood paella, the almond cake, THE SANGRIA was the bomb!  We love barcelona!!!
author: Roger P
